I studied abroad for one year at Utrecht University, in the Netherlands. I chose to finish my degree abroad because I wanted to broaden my educational experiences and perspectives even further. The Netherlands has some remarkable differences in both educational and environmental perspectives that enhanced my education more than I expected.

### Notable courses:

##### Landscape Ecology and Nature Conservation

##### Integrated Water and Soil Management

##### Environmental Impact Assessment

##### Applied Data Analysis and Visualization
